name: Support Reply Macros
summary: Writes reusable support replies for your most common tickets, using only the product facts you approve.
description: Turns your recurring support questions into reply macros: when to use each, the reply text in your tone, personalisation slots, and an internal note. Every product fact in a reply is listed and must be copied from the facts you supply, so agents never promise a feature, limit or policy that does not exist. Who it's for: support leads and small teams who answer the same questions every day. Limitations: replies cover the facts given; anything else is left as a slot for the agent to fill. It does not connect to your helpdesk.
problems: We answer the same support tickets every day
Support replies are inconsistent between agents
I need canned responses for common questions

inputs.label: Common questions
inputs.description: Recurring tickets or questions, one per line.
inputs.example:
How do I change my billing email?
Why did my bank connection stop syncing?

inputs.label: Approved facts
inputs.description: Facts and policies agents may state.
inputs.example: Billing email is changed under Settings > Billing. Bank connections must be re-authorised every 90 days.

outputs.label: Macros
outputs.description: Reply macros with usage notes, slots and facts used.

execution.system: You write support macros. Replies are short, warm and solve the problem in as few steps as possible. Only state facts from the approved list; anything else becomes a {slot} for the agent.

items.description: Copied word for word from the approved facts.

gaps.title: Questions the facts do not cover

steps.name: Write macros
steps.responsibility: Write a macro per common question.
steps.prompt: Write one macro per common question. Keep replies under 120 words. Copy every product fact a reply relies on exactly into facts_used. Use {slots} for details the agent must fill. List questions the facts cannot answer under gaps.

steps.name: Check macros
steps.responsibility: Facts come from the approved list; replies are short; titles unique.

criteria.description: Every fact used is copied from the approved facts.
